name: X (Twitter)

disclosure.zh: X 的帖子没有「AI 生成」开关：视频是 AI 生成或做过逼真的修改时，在文字里说明（X 合成与篡改媒体政策）。普通账号：正文按加权计 280 字（中文、emoji 算 2，链接算 23），视频 ≤ 140 秒 / 512 MB；Premium 更长。发布前检查「谁可以回复」。
disclosure.en: X posts have no "AI-generated" switch: when the video is AI-made or realistically altered, say so in the text (X synthetic and manipulated media policy). Standard accounts: 280 weighted characters (CJK and emoji count 2, a link 23), video <= 140 s / 512 MB; Premium allows more. Check "Who can reply" before posting.

guide.zh: 页面会打开发帖窗口；应用放入视频、填好正文（含 1–2 个话题标签）。视频处理完、字数没变红，再由你点「发帖」。
guide.en: The compose window opens; the app adds the video and types the text (with 1-2 hashtags). When the video has processed and the counter is not red, press Post yourself.

zh: 是否标注 AI 生成（写在正文里）
en: Whether to say it is AI-generated (in the text)

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written without a logged-in session, 2026-10): data-testid values are what x.com used through 2025; check them on the live page and set status to verified + lastVerified.
The post text is a Draft.js editor: text is typed with Input.insertText; the 280 limit is weighted (twitter-text v3) - the desk warns, it never cuts (Premium accounts may post more).
X may refuse unusual browsers; if the login page loops, sign in once with the Google/Apple popup or try again later.
